en.dr-ali-peiravi: 7-6 Muhammad ibn Ja’far al-Bindar narrated that Abul-Abbas al-Himady quoted on the authority of Abu Ja’far al-Hazrami, on the authority of Hodbat ibn Khalid, on the authority of Homam ibn Yahya, on the authority of Qitadeh, on the authority of Aymen, on the authority of Abi Imamat that
God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “Blessed be those who believe in me without having seen me.” He (MGB) then repeated it seven times.
